digest.component_or_area: completion-recovery context bounds and close-gate failure diagnostics
propositions: Tickets exceeding the 24,000-char context limit cannot close via bounded recovery, blocking correct merged work when ticket size is legitimate (34,282 chars measured on ticket 9fd4)
The context bound (24,000 chars) is incoherent with the criteria bound (32,000 chars); a criteria set within its own limit can breach the context limit, triggering a refusal

A step-budget exhaustion in the completion verifier incorrectly reports 'install the agents extra' instead of surfacing the actual cause, because recovery_failure_cause() returns None for CompletionRecoveryError
Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars covers measured real tickets (9fd4: 34,282 chars, 2932: 41,595 chars) while maintaining the cost guard (zero billable recovery calls on breach)
